summary.zh-TW: 三個統計數字從 0 跳到目標值，一開始很快、最後慢慢停在正確的數字。按 Refresh 換成新數字時，會從目前的值跳過去，不會每次都從 0 開始。
summary.en: Three stats count up from 0 — fast at first, settling on the exact value. Refresh jumps from the current value to new numbers instead of restarting at 0.

text.zh-TW: GSAP 不只能動畫元素，也能動畫一個普通物件的數字。改 c.n，再在 onUpdate 裡把它格式化成文字寫回畫面。
text.en: GSAP can tween a plain object’s number, not just elements. It changes c.n, and onUpdate formats it back into the text on screen.

text.zh-TW: 千分位、貨幣符號、小數位數交給瀏覽器內建的格式化，換語言或幣別時只要改設定，不用自己拼字串。
text.en: Thousands separators, currency symbols and decimals come from the built-in formatter; switching locale or currency is a setting, not string building.

text.zh-TW: 等寬數字：跳動時每個數字一樣寬，整串數字不會左右抖動。所有會變動的數字（計時、價格）都建議加。
text.en: Tabular figures keep every digit the same width so the number doesn’t wobble while counting. Use it for any changing number — timers, prices.

text.zh-TW: 大部分時間花在最後幾個數字，眼睛來得及讀到結果。用 none（等速）會一直快速閃動到最後一刻才停。
text.en: Most of the time is spent on the last digits so the eye can catch the result. Linear (none) flickers fast right up to the final frame.

text.zh-TW: 每個數字記住目前顯示的值，Refresh 時從這裡跳到新值。配上 overwrite: true，連按也不會跳回 0。
text.en: Each counter remembers its current value and refreshes from there. With overwrite: true, repeated clicks never snap back to 0.
